_comment: Known-issue baseline for the feed validation gate (scripts/validate-feeds.sh).
The gate fails when a validator reports an ERROR code that is NOT listed here.
It deliberately does not gate on occurrence COUNTS: those track how many trains
are running and fluctuate legitimately between runs. A new error CODE is a real
regression; a changing count is not.
Entries here are technical debt to burn down, not permanent exemptions.
Remove a code once it is fixed so the gate ratchets tighter.

static._note: Amtrak's official GTFS currently produces zero ERROR notices, so any error here is a genuine regression.

allowed_error_codes.E003: trip_id not in GTFS. Amtrak operates extra sections and trains absent from the published schedule.
allowed_error_codes.E004: route_id not in GTFS. Same root cause as E003.
allowed_error_codes.E011: stop_id not in GTFS. Live data references stations missing from the static feed.
allowed_error_codes.E022: Sequential stop_time_update times not increasing. Upstream Amtrak estimate ordering.
allowed_error_codes.E025: departure time before arrival time. Upstream Amtrak estimate inconsistency.
allowed_error_codes.E029: Vehicle position far from trip shape. Also flagged as a WARNING-level data issue (stop_too_far_from_shape) in Amtrak's own static feed.
allowed_error_codes.E035: trip_id does not belong to route_id in trips.txt. Upstream matching mismatch.
allowed_error_codes.E039: FULL_DATASET feed includes entity.is_deleted. Emitted by the upstream transform; fixable on our side by stripping the field.
allowed_error_codes.E041: trip has no stop_time_updates. Trains with no remaining predicted stops.
allowed_error_codes.E043: stop_time_update has neither arrival nor departure. Upstream omits both for some stops.
allowed_error_codes.E049: header incrementality not populated. Fixable on our side by setting it explicitly.
